data.body: [P2] Adding an eighth component still changes this public record's contract despite retaining the seven-argument constructor: existing seven-component record patterns no longer compile, while equality, hashing, reflection, and serializer-visible shape now include the header. Keep `InvocationInfo` at seven components and carry the snapshot in separate immutable metadata, delivered through a new default plugin-hook overload that delegates to the existing `onInvocationStart(InvocationInfo)` hook.
